description: Exports one screen of a CLASSIC WinCC HMI to an XML file on the serve host. WinCC Unified screens have no file export in the V21 API (the serve refuses them). Writes the file only — the project is not changed. Maps to POST /hmi/{hmi}/screens/{screen}/export {path}. Class M-off. Long operation: may answer status:"running" + jobId — then call tia_job_status.

dryRun.description: Gd11: plan-without-applying — validates the guards and describes the action WITHOUT mutating the project

path.description: target .xml file path on the serve host

name: tia_hmi_screen_export
title: TIA — export HMI screen (Classic)
